# SECRET_STORE

A named store an ExternalSecret reads from, and whether it may be written to.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `secretStore`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.secretStore`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| storeKind | one of ["SecretStore", "ClusterSecretStore"] |
| storeName | string |
| writable | bool |
